announcements.title: Welcome to WeType
announcements.body: This is the in-app What's New feed. When there's a new release or a change worth knowing about, a note will appear here — no email, no Discord. You can reopen this any time from the menu-bar icon.

announcements.title: Suggestions now work inside Microsoft Word
announcements.body: WeType can now read Word's editable text area and place suggestions inside your document. Update to the latest version to get it.
